```

stat_metadata

```

```{r}

```

```{r}
dataset_metadata%>%group_by(active_cluster, time)%>%tally()%>%mutate(percentage=n/sum(n)*100)->stat_metadata
```


```{r}
p<-ggplot(stat_metadata%>%mutate_at(vars(percentage), round, digits =2),aes(x=time,y=percentage,fill=time))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity",position=position_dodge())+
  #scale_fill_manual(values=ucols)+
  ylim(0,60)+
  geom_text(aes(label=n), vjust=1.6, color="white", size=3.5,position = position_dodge(0.9))+
  geom_text(aes(label=percentage), vjust=-0.3, color="black", size=3.5,position = position_dodge(0.9))+
  labs(title= "grouped by time",
       subtitle = "n=11200")+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  facet_grid(cols=(vars(active_cluster)))
  
```

read seurat object
```{r}
integrated_seurat <- RBC
integrated_seurat<-readRDS(file="/home/shared_data_vclab_2/SCRNAseq_cordblood/SCRNAseq_cordblood_pakkanan/hemoglobin_containing_dataset.rds")
```

```{r}
expression_table<-GetAssayData(object = integrated_seurat, assay = "RNA")%>%data.frame%>%rownames_to_column()
```

```{r}
new_cds_leiden_01<-readRDS("/home/shared_data_vclab_2/SCRNAseq_cordblood/SCRNAseq_cordblood_pakkanan/cod/revised_analyses_March/new_cds_leiden_01.rds")
```

```{r}
cols_pll = c("cyan","blue","hotpink", "red")
cluster_labels=c("early_HBG","late_HBG","early_HBB", "late_HBB")
```

```{r}
hemoglobin_genes <- c("CENPX","NME2", "BCL11A", "KLF1", "GATA1", "IKAROS", "MYB", "HBG2")
hemoglobin_cds <- new_cds_leiden_01[rowData(new_cds_leiden_01)$gene_short_name %in% hemoglobin_genes,]

pT_leiden<-data.frame(pseudotime_coordinate=pseudotime(hemoglobin_cds))
```
select gene
```{r}
selected_gene_table<-expression_table%>%filter(rowname %in% c("CENPX","NME2", "BCL11A", "KLF1", "GATA1", "IKAROS", "MYB", "HBG2"))%>%column_to_rownames()%>%t%>%data.frame()%>%rownames_to_column
```

```{r}
integrated_seurat$active_cluster<-Idents(integrated_seurat)
```

```{r}
info_table<-integrated_seurat$active_cluster%>%data.frame(active_cluster=.)%>%rownames_to_column()
```

```{r}
expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden<-pT_leiden%>%rownames_to_column%>%left_join(selected_gene_table,by="rowname")%>%left_join(info_table,by="rowname")
```

```{r}
pseudoleiden_NME2<-ggplot(expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden, aes(x=pseudotime_coordinate,y=NME2,color=active_cluster))+geom_point(size=0.25)
```
```{r}
expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden
```

```{r}
expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden_mod1<-expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden%>%separate("active_cluster", into = c("time","marker"),remove = FALSE)
```
NME2
```{r}
plot_pseudo_1<-ggplot(expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden_mod1, aes(x=pseudotime_coordinate,y=NME2,color=HBG2))+
  geom_point(size=0.25)+
  scale_color_gradient(low = "purple", high="yellow")+
  #guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=5)))+
  #scale_color_manual(values=setNames(cols_pll,cluster_labels))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_smooth(data = expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden_mod1,
              aes(x=pseudotime_coordinate,y=NME2),
              method = "loess",
              inherit.aes = FALSE)
```

```{r}
plot_pseudo_facet<-ggplot(expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden_mod1, aes(x=pseudotime_coordinate,y=NME2,color=active_cluster))+
  geom_point(size=0.25)+
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=5)))+
  scale_color_manual(values=setNames(cols_pll,cluster_labels))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_smooth(data = expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden_mod1,
              aes(x=pseudotime_coordinate,y=NME2),
              method = "loess",
              inherit.aes = FALSE)+
  facet_grid(cols = vars(marker))
```

heatmap from seurat
```{r}
plot_seurat_heatmap<-function(integrated_seurat,task_name,assay="integrated",slot="scale.data"){
  name = paste0(directory,task_name)
  png(filename = paste0(name,"_heatmap_fullheatmap.png"), width=1200, height=5000)
  p<-DoHeatmap(integrated_seurat, assay = assay,slot=slot, features = VariableFeatures(integrated_seurat)[1:500], cells = 1:500, size = 4, angle = 90)
print(p)
dev.off()
}
plot_seurat_heatmap_cluster<-function(integrated_seurat,task_name,assay="integrated",slot="scale.data"){
  name = paste0(directory,task_name)
  png(filename = paste0(name,"_heatmap_fullheatmap",assay,".png"), width=1200, height=5000)
  p<-DoHeatmap(subset(integrated_seurat,ident=c("early_HBG_(0)","late_HBG_(2)","early_HBB_(3)","late_HBB_(1)")), assay = assay,slot=slot, features = VariableFeatures(integrated_seurat)[1:500], cells = 1:500, size = 4, angle = 90)
print(p)
dev.off()
}
```

clustering

Define clustering function
```{r}
data_cluster<-function(target_table){
  hclust_object<-target_table%>%
  dplyr::select(-contains("max_val"),-contains("min_val"),-contains("max_fc"),-contains("min_fc"),-contains("passed_count"),-contains("passed_count_fc"),-contains("cluster"))%>%
  column_to_rownames("rowname")%>%
  as.matrix()%>%
  hclust.vector(method="ward",metric="euclidean")
  print("cluster done")
  return(hclust_object)
}
```
Define update main table function
```{r}
update_table_with_cluster<-function(target_table,hclust_object,cluster_number){
  target_table%>%
  left_join(hclust_object%>%
  cutree(k=cluster_number)%>%
  data.frame()%>%
  rename_at(vars(.),funs(paste0("cluster")))%>%
  rownames_to_column(), by=c("rowname"="rowname"))
}
```
Define add index function
```{r}
add_index<-function(target_table,hclust_object){
  target_table[hclust_object$order,]%>%
  cbind.data.frame(idx=seq(1:nrow(.)))
}

```

Define change cluster order function
```{r}
cluster_reorder<-function(target_table){
  order_of_cluster<-target_table%>%select(cluster)%>%unlist%>%unique%>%as.character
  hashmap_of_cluster<-order_of_cluster%>%hashmap(1:length(order_of_cluster))
  target_table$cluster<-hashmap_of_cluster[[target_table%>%select(contains("cluster"))%>%unlist]]
  return(target_table)
}
```

lazy heatmap
```{r}
make_lazyheatmap<-function(matrix_or_interest,heatmap_name){Heatmap(matrix_or_interest, 
                        #heatmap internal name
                        name="fold change",
                        #column ordering and dendogram config
                        show_column_dend = FALSE,
                        cluster_columns = FALSE,
                        #row ordering and dendrogram config
                        show_row_dend = FALSE, 
                        cluster_rows = FALSE,
                        #title config
                        column_title = heatmap_name,
                        #row and column name config
                        show_row_names = TRUE, 
                        show_column_names = TRUE,
                        column_names_side = "top",
                        row_names_side = "left", 
                        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15),
                        #color scale config
                        col = colorRamp2(c(-2,0,5), c("blue","grey","red")),
                        #borderconfig
                        rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 2),
                        #split=5
                        #set legend
              
                        #split=splitter,
                        use_raster = TRUE,
                        #annotation
                        #top_annotation = column_annotation_object
                        
                        )
  
}
```

#define funtion to convert all markers table to tf only table
select_tf<-function(marker_table){
  marker_table%>%
    rownames_to_column()%>%
    left_join(gene_symbol_table, by=c("rowname"="external_gene_name"))%>%
    left_join(human_tf_db,by=("ensembl_gene_id"))%>%
    filter(Is_TF=="Yes")%>%
    dplyr::select(rowname,p_val,avg_logFC,pct.1,pct.2,p_val_adj)
}

select_tf_onegroup<-function(marker_table){
  marker_table%>%
    rownames_to_column()%>%
    left_join(gene_symbol_table, by=c("gene"="external_gene_name"))%>%
    left_join(human_tf_db,by=("ensembl_gene_id"))%>%
    filter(Is_TF=="Yes")%>%
    dplyr::select(gene,p_val,avg_logFC,pct.1,pct.2,p_val_adj)
}
gglazyplot<-function(gene1,gene2,DF){
  ggplot(DF%>%data.frame, aes_string(x=gene1, y=gene2)) + 
    geom_point(size=0.5)+
    geom_smooth(method=lm,size=0.5,se=FALSE,color="red")+
    scale_color_gradient2(low="red", high="blue", midpoint = 0, mid="grey", limit=c(-1,2))
}
